SELECT 
    se.zoneref,
    s.zonelabel,
    AVG(
        CASE 
            WHEN se.esi > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN se.esi BETWEEN 70 AND 85 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN se.esi BETWEEN 50 AND 70 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
            ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions'
        END
    ) AS avg_scanning_suitability
FROM 
    scanenvironment se
JOIN 
    sites s ON se.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY 
    s.zonelabel, se.zoneref, s.zoneregistry
ORDER BY 
    avg_scanning_suitability DESC;
